name: Greenfield Organics
bio: Family-run greenhouse in Denver specializing in vine-ripened tomatoes and seasonal produce for restaurants and retailers.

name: Highland Farms
bio: Highland-area growers of sweet organic carrots and root vegetables in rich Colorado soil.

name: Sunrise Coop
bio: Cooperative in Aurora raising pasture free-range hens for deep-orange-yolk eggs.

name: Plains Grain Co.
bio: High-protein hard red winter wheat grown on the plains near Golden for milling and baking.

name: Orchard Lane
bio: Seasonal Colorado apple orchard offering Honeycrisp, Gala, and cider varieties.

name: Brighton Creamery
bio: Small-batch artisan cheddar aged 12 months, available in wheels or food-service cuts.

name: Valley Spud
bio: Buttery Yukon Gold potatoes, washed and graded for bulk or retail sacks.

name: Herb Garden
bio: Hydroponic culinary herb mixes (basil, parsley, cilantro, thyme) grown weekly.

name: Mountain Berry
bio: Tree-ripened Colorado peaches from the foothills, ideal for fresh market or preserves.

name: Grain Elevator
bio: Certified organic oats, rolled or whole, for processors and bakeries.
